title.zh: 反例：愿意留下与不得不留下

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的两位伴侣商量是否继续每周一起读一段自编故事。一人愿意保留伴侣身份，却不想继续原来的朗读形式；另一人喜欢朗读，却还没想好关系安排。喜欢一项活动、愿意继续关系和已经达成共同约定，是三件需要分别表达的事。即使第一人的本组读数较高，也不能替第二人补出承诺。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two fictional partners discuss continuing a weekly reading of their own stories. One wants to remain partners but change the reading format; the other enjoys reading but is unsure about the relationship arrangement. Enjoying an activity, wanting the partnership to continue and having a mutual agreement are separate statements. A higher intention reading for the first person cannot supply a commitment for the second.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先写：“我现在愿意继续的是……，希望改变的是……，还不知道你的想法是……。”三处都可以留空。若只想分享内容，可以发公开指南，不必发送个人分数，也不要求对方重测或给出相同回答。
paragraphs.en: You could privately draft: “What I currently want to continue is …; what I want to change is …; what I do not yet know about your view is ….” Any space can remain blank. To share the material, use the public guide without personal scores or requiring another person to retake the test or answer alike.

paragraphs.zh: 本页案例为原创说明，不是对你、伴侣或关系未来的判断。四组各六条，分别保留均分与有效题数，不合成一个总承诺分；任一NA只使所属部分保留资料不足，四份完整指南仍可阅读。可以只读或写不发送的草稿，不需要披露答案、生活细节或采取关系行动。
paragraphs.en: These original examples do not judge you, a partner or a relationship’s future. Four groups of six retain separate means and rated counts, without a total commitment score. Any NA withholds only its own part, while all four complete guides remain readable. Reading or drafting an unsent note is enough, without disclosing answers, personal circumstances or taking relationship action.

title.zh: 反例：少见面不自动等于不满意
title.en: Counterexample: limited time together is not automatically dissatisfaction

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的两人共同制作故事册，第一次交谈很愉快，后来几次却总在匆忙中结束。一人欣赏最初的体验，也希望下次留出完整说话时间。一次愉快经历不替整个月作答，近期不满意也不自动否定全部共同经历。这里问体验是否符合自己的需要；是否仍想维持伴侣身份，需要另读继续意愿。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, fictional partners make a story booklet. Their first conversation feels rewarding, while later ones repeatedly end in a rush. One values the first experience and wants time to finish speaking next time. One enjoyable event cannot answer for a whole month, and recent dissatisfaction does not erase every shared experience. This part concerns how experience fits your needs; wanting to remain partners belongs to intention.

title.zh: 把一件体验变成可讨论的安排
title.en: Turn one experience into a discussable arrangement

paragraphs.zh: 可以写：“我想到的具体互动是……；对我有帮助或让我不满意的部分是……；我希望了解你当时怎样理解。”先写事件，再写自己的体验。无需证明谁记忆更正确，也不把同一事件的不同感受平均成双方的满意分。
paragraphs.en: You could write: “The interaction I have in mind is …; what helped or felt unsatisfactory to me was …; what I would like to understand about your view then is ….” Describe the event and your experience separately. You need not prove whose memory is correct or average different feelings into a shared satisfaction score.

title.zh: 反例：很少选择不证明关系更牢固
title.en: Counterexample: few perceived options do not prove durability

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的伴侣一方喜欢独自去图书馆，也相信可以与朋友保持联系，但朋友是否能在某个具体时段提供帮助还没有确认。喜欢一种生活、主观上认为可行与实际能获得支持并不相同；朋友人数也不提供答案。此人仍可愿意继续当前关系，不需要用减少其他联系来证明本组读数“应该更低”。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, one fictional partner enjoys visiting a library alone and believes friendships can continue, but has not confirmed whether a friend could help at a particular time. Liking a way of living, perceiving it as feasible and actually being able to access support are different observations. The number of friends supplies no answer. The person can still want the partnership to continue without reducing other connections to make this reading lower.

title.zh: 一个不上传的支持资源练习

paragraphs.zh: 可以问自己：“我知道已经可用的是什么，哪部分只是想象，哪部分还需要了解？”只记类别即可，不用列联系人。分享时可讨论这个区分，而不是比较谁更容易找到替代伴侣；也不用通过离开、约会或寻求谁的保证来验证均分。
paragraphs.en: Ask yourself: “What do I know is available, what am I imagining, and what would I need to understand?” Categories are enough, without a contact list. Sharing can concern this distinction rather than comparing who could find another partner more easily. No departure, dating attempt or reassurance from anyone is needed to validate a mean.

title.zh: 反例：在一起多年，也可能保持独立安排
title.en: Counterexample: years together can include independent arrangements

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的两人共同做过故事册，也分别保留了自己的原稿。过去花去的时间已经发生；当前合写稿、仍需协商的后续安排、各自可继续使用的原稿则是不同事项。哪些资源会因关系变化而改变，要核对具体条件，不能只数合作年数。整理共同事务不等于已经决定继续，也不使任何一方欠下一段关系。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, fictional partners have made a story booklet and each retained a personal draft. Time already spent is in the past; the current joint manuscript, future arrangements still requiring discussion and personal drafts that remain usable are different matters. Which resources would change with the relationship depends on specific conditions, not just years of collaboration. Organising shared matters neither decides continuation nor creates a relationship debt.

title.zh: 三栏清单：保留、协调、尚不清楚
title.en: A private inventory: retained, coordinated and unknown

paragraphs.zh: 可以把一句“我们投入很多”拆成：“我想到的资源是……；是否仍可保留，我已知的是……；需要另行核对的是……。”只写愿意记录的类别。不要据此估价伴侣、推定财产权或要求增加投入；共享指南也不需要共享这份私人清单。
paragraphs.en: Break “we have invested a lot” into: “The resource I mean is …; what I know about retaining it is …; what needs checking separately is ….” Record only categories you want to keep. This does not price a partner, determine ownership rights or justify demanding more investment. Sharing the guide does not require sharing the private inventory.
